text:
taylor: Quick thread  We need a focused social play for the May webinar (X + LinkedIn). Objective: signups + plant a benchmark narrative (latency vs cost tradeoffs using Redwood Optimize). Can we map creative, cadence, and routing?
jamie: Proposed cadence: Mon (APAC tease), Tue morning (announce), Tue 30m before (reminder), Wed recap. X gets short threads; LinkedIn gets one announcement + recap post.
nina: Creative ask: hero 16:9, 20s autoplay clip, bench chart (PNG), 2 quote cards, registration link with UTM. Deliver by Thu noon.
marco: Routing: tag leads with "webinar_may_opt". Tiered routing: enterprise -> SDR team 1 (24h), mid-market -> growth-nurture (48h). Include `priority` and `vertical` columns in CSV.
taylor: Caption A/B for LinkedIn please (short punchy vs technical). Also need 2 X thread variants for A/B testing on copy length.
jamie: Drafts: LinkedIn Short: "How we reduced inference cost and improved latency. Live demo + benchmark — May 14." LinkedIn Tech: "Deep dive: runtime tweaks, batching, and quantization that yielded 2x latency at 30% lower token cost. Join the demo."
nina: Uploading assets here: https://drive.google.com/webinar-may-assets. Filenames: hero_may.jpg, clip20.mp4, bench_may.png, quote_ops.png, quote_ceo.png
marco: CSV headers I'll accept: `email,name,company,title,score,vertical,tag,sdr_queue,priority,followup_by`. I'll add routing rules once CSV is posted.
scheduler-bot: Scheduled posts: X APAC tease -> 2026-05-11T07:00:00Z (owner: jamie); LinkedIn announce -> 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z (owner: nina); X reminder -> 2026-05-13T16:30:00Z (owner: nina).
taylor: Legal note: avoid absolute superlatives. Use phrasing like "measured up to 2x" or "in our tests" and get legal signoff before publish.
jamie: I'll own seedlist and send CSV by Fri 10am PT. Will include verticals and an initial score column.
nina: For no-shows, automated email at 24h with recording + CTA. Tag CRM record `no_show_may`.
taylor: Post-launch: monitor sentiment + engagement. If negative bench questions pop up, escalate to comms + research for a detailed thread. Who owns first 12h monitoring?
marco: I'll take the first 6, jamie takes next 6.
taylor: Great. Quick sync Thu 9am PT to confirm assets + legal copy. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
jamie: +1
nina: +1
